definition_quote.value: The practice of the profession of medicine is defined as diagnosing, treating, operating or prescribing for any human disease, pain, injury, deformity or physical condition.

drug_authority.value: Licensed physicians may prescribe and order drugs, including non-patient specific regimens to registered professional nurses for immunizations and emergency treatments, and patient-specific or non-patient specific orders to licensed pharmacists for immunizations, HIV post-exposure prophylaxis, insulin and related supplies, and self-administered hormonal contraceptives.
drug_authority.quote: A licensed physician may prescribe and order a non-patient specific regimen to a registered professional nurse, pursuant to regulations promulgated by the commissioner

license_status_types.quote: The licensure status of such licensee shall be "inactive" and he or she shall not be authorized to practice the profession

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates who are US residents must have studied at a WHO-recognized foreign medical school, completed all formal requirements except internship/social service, attained a qualifying examination score satisfactory to an LCME-approved medical school with one year of supervised clinical training, completed required postgraduate hospital training, and passed the licensing examination. Alternatively, a foreign physician may qualify for a limited permit by holding an ECFMG standard certificate or passing an examination satisfactory to the state board.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: has studied medicine in a medical school located outside the United States which is recognized by the World Health Organization; has completed all of the formal requirements of the foreign medical school except internship and/or social service; has attained a score satisfactory to a medical school approved by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education on a qualifying examination acceptable to the state board for medicine, and has satisfactorily completed one academic year of supervised clinical training under the direction of such medical school
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.citation: 6528 - Qualification of Certain Applicants for Licensure.

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: There shall be appointed within the department, by the board of regents, a committee on drug and alcohol abuse, which shall advise the board of regents on matters relating to practice by professional licensees with drug or alcohol abuse problems, and which shall administer the provisions of this section.
